scope: Actual synthetic primary and refit results; no scientific outcome changed

operational.scope: Immutable dataset lineage and successful solver/native restoration only

statistical.scope: Screened numerical and sensitivity diagnostics; model correctness is not guaranteed

limitations: Imported assignments and review declarations do not authenticate randomization or execution
Compatible placebos and negative controls do not prove exchangeability
No automatic causal claim, extrapolation across populations or budget action
Geographic experiments require independent geo units; repeated days are not independent geos
Multiplicity across separate experiments and transportability require a prespecified design review

stability.acceptance_basis: Prespecified relative estimate/prediction spread; independent seeds, regularization and omission of first control where available
limitations: Omitting a control is a stress test, not a recommendation to remove a confounder
Stable predictions can coexist with unidentified channel effects
No prior-sensitivity certification; defaults and effective priors are recorded

warnings: No automatic causal or investment certification; missing evidence remains inconclusive
